The '''Greater Menagerie''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] vault in the [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Located in the [[Ancient Stasis Zone]] of the Tomb, the vault was used to contain monstrous creatures from the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], and one of those creatures attempted to break out of the Menagerie's lower levels after the facility was damaged during the [[invasion of Belsavis]]. However, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Valn]] recruited [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] individuals to seal the creature back into the Menagerie.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Greater Menagerie appears as a location on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the Republic mission "Containing the Beast."<ref name="TOR" />
